name: segment the moving subject from a static background via frame differencing
definition: Use per-frame motion/background subtraction to isolate the foreground runner from the unchanged background so its bounding extent can be tracked.
failure_mode: Background noise or lighting makes subject tracking unreliable

name: send crafted messages over the web messaging protocol
definition: Establish a messaging session and publish/subscribe to topics or invoke handlers by sending protocol-formatted messages.
failure_mode: Malformed messages or wrong session handshake prevent reaching the vulnerable handler.
